backend/main.mo: Defines the actor canister with user profiles, provider data, jobs, MPesa config, document storage, and authorization/storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Lists PWA‑related features with associated files, components, and test IDs for feature‑tracking.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains human‑written summaries for major frontend files used for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base/theme definitions with OKLCH color variables and dark‑mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including PWA manifest, iOS PWA metadata, and script bootstrap.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, colors, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page displayed when the user loses internet connectivity.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing installability, offline caching for static assets, and safe exclusion of authenticated API requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling auth, onboarding, navigation, and page rendering with React Query and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, support drawer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and session clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Role selection UI for new users that saves the chosen role via mutation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright, support trigger, and link attribution with dynamic year and hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with logo, role‑based navigation, PWA install button, support trigger, and login/logout actions.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Empty placeholder file for a landing page demo video section.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Displays animated client and provider stats with minimum thresholds and backend count integration.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Renders static client testimonials with provider avatars and rating stars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder hook for landing page scroll‑related behavior.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Form component for entering or auto-filling address and coordinates using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Messaging UI that displays a message list and allows sending and refreshing simulated messages.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Dialog handling M-Pesa payment flow including phone validation, initiation, polling, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Avatar component for featured providers with fallback initials and size options.
Static showcase grid of demo provider cards with avatars, ratings, and details.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Provider avatar component showing profile picture or initials with size variants.
Clickable provider summary card showing avatar, verification status, location, rate, category, and rating.
Dialog displaying provider preview details including avatar, availability, category, location, and actions.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: A card component showing locked provider contact details, connection fee info, and an unlock button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: A banner prompting users to install the PWA, with platform-specific behavior and an iOS instructions dialog.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: A 1–5 star rating input component allowing selection unless set to readonly.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: A drawer providing customer support contact options including phone and email.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: A hook that animates a number counting up once its referenced element becomes visible via IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and access to identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: A hook managing PWA install prompt availability, iOS detection, and triggering the install flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, provider data, and search using an actor-based backend. Includes mutations for role and profile updates with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and theme variables for light/dark modes with custom colors and landing page background styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with icons and helpers to retrieve categories and readable business type labels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Provides an admin interface to review provider profiles, view statuses, and approve or reject verification requests.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigates to results based on selected category.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Displays providers on a map view, shows an alert when Google Maps is not configured, and lists providers with navigation to details.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Shows the user's job requests with status, allows cancelling or completing jobs, and supports rating upon completion.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays detailed provider information, verification status, hiring workflow, and unlock/payment logic including M-Pesa support.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists providers filtered by category and search, supports preview dialogs, and navigation to map or detail views.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing landing page with hero, stats, featured providers, testimonials, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to edit their profile, upload a profile picture, set service details, and update location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Shows provider verification status and enables uploading academic and conduct documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides utility functions to calculate a 10% connection fee and format KES amounts.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading URL and hash parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, content paths, custom fonts, colors, container settings, and extended design tokens.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state, requirements, issues, and architectural notes for building the Genz App marketplace.
